name: chattingapp
description: A complete chat and social platform with a FastAPI backend and a React + Vite frontend.

scripts.backend:install: cd backend && set SSL_CERT_FILE=& set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=& set CURL_CA_BUNDLE=& venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.backend: cd backend && set SSL_CERT_FILE=& set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=& set CURL_CA_BUNDLE=& venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.backend:migrate: cd backend && set SSL_CERT_FILE=& set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=& set CURL_CA_BUNDLE=& venv\Scripts\python.exe -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.backend:migrate:revision: cd backend && set SSL_CERT_FILE=& set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=& set CURL_CA_BUNDLE=& venv\Scripts\python.exe -m alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.backend:migrate:history: cd backend && set SSL_CERT_FILE=& set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=& set CURL_CA_BUNDLE=& venv\Scripts\python.exe -m alembic history --verbose
scripts.dev: concurrently --restart-tries 10 --restart-after 1000 -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run frontend:wait"
